name: The Snowman Experience at Dania Pointe
when_note: Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to December 27, 3 to 8 PM
paras: Dania Pointe lists The Snowman Experience on Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to December 27, 2026, from 3 PM to 8 PM on The Lawn at 150 Sunset Drive.
Families can take festive photos alongside real snowmen. The shopping center describes it as a way to celebrate the season, and its events page does not print a price.
tip: Go late afternoon on a weekend so you can stay for the evening snowfall.

name: Let It Snow at Dania Pointe
when_note: Fridays and Saturdays 7 and 8:30 PM, Sundays 7 PM, with bonus shows December 21 to 24, 26 and 27
paras: Dania Pointe lists Let It Snow as a 15 minute snowfall on The Lawn every weekend from November 27 through December 20, 2026. Showtimes are 7 PM and 8:30 PM on Fridays and Saturdays and 7 PM on Sundays.
Bonus shows run at 7 PM and 8:30 PM on December 21 to 24 and December 26, and at 7 PM on December 27. The events page does not print a price.
tip: Pick the 7 PM show if little ones go to bed early.
